description: This file defines the RandomGenerator interface in the org.apache.commons.math3.random package. It specifies methods for setting seeds and generating various types of random values, serving as an abstraction layer for random number generators within the Apache Commons Math library.

classes.name: RandomGenerator
classes.description: An interface defining methods for a random number generator, including seed setting and generating various types of pseudo-random values.

methods.name: setSeed
methods.description: Sets the seed for the underlying random number generator, overloads for int, int[] and long types.

methods.name: nextBytes
methods.description: Fills a byte array with random bytes.

methods.name: nextInt
methods.description: Returns a random integer, either unbounded or bounded.

methods.name: nextFloat
methods.description: Returns a random float between 0.0 and 1.0.

methods.name: nextDouble
methods.description: Returns a random double between 0.0 and 1.0.

methods.name: nextGaussian
methods.description: Returns a normally distributed Gaussian value.
